title: How to rediscover past candidates in your ATS on Mac: a guide for recruiters
metaTitle: Rediscover past candidates in your ATS: Mac recruiting guide
description: Stop searching for candidates you already have. Learn how to rediscover past candidates in your ATS on Mac without extra costs.
targetKeyword: rediscover past candidates in your ATS
intro: You can rediscover past candidates in your ATS by shifting from keyword-only searches to semantic search and data enrichment. Many recruiters ignore their existing database because they do not trust the results, but your ATS is likely full of talent you already paid to source.
tldr: Stop treating your ATS like a static filing cabinet.
Use semantic search to find skills, not just exact keywords.
Enrich stale profiles with updated public data to keep your database alive.
Group your ATS and sourcing tabs in browser spaces to keep workflows clean.
Lazur helps you search faster by pointing at the right filters on your screen.

blocks.text: The hidden cost of ignoring your ATS

Every time you source a candidate who is already in your database, you pay twice. You pay for the initial outreach and the time it took to screen that person months ago. When the ATS search fails, you instinctively head to LinkedIn or other external boards. This creates a cycle of duplicate work that drains your budget and your energy.

The time-to-fill metric is a clear indicator of this inefficiency. Between 2019 and 2024, these rates increased by 23 percent. Much of this delay comes from the administrative tax of managing disconnected systems. When your ATS feels like a black hole, you lose the competitive advantage of speed.

The problem is rarely your organization. It is the architecture of most ATS platforms. They rely on rigid keyword matching. If you search for 'Critical Care' but the candidate listed 'ICU' on their resume, the system returns nothing. This is a technical failure, not a human one.

Stale data is the second hurdle. Candidates change jobs every two to three years. If you rely on a resume from 18 months ago, the contact info and job titles are likely wrong. Without a way to refresh this data, the database becomes a static bin rather than a living asset.

If you are recruiting for regulated roles like nursing, law, or accounting, always follow your employer rules regarding patient or client data privacy. Never export personal data into unauthorized spreadsheets or tools.
blocks.title: Data Privacy Note

items: Audit your search filters: Look for 'Boolean' search options in your ATS. Learn the syntax for your specific platform (e.g., AND, OR, NOT).
Use semantic search: If your ATS supports it, switch from 'Keyword' to 'Semantic' or 'AI' search. This helps the system understand that 'Project Manager' and 'Program Manager' are related.
Standardize tags: Create a consistent tagging system for skills. If everyone uses different tags, your search will never return complete results.
Clear your workspace: Use browser profiles in Chrome or Safari to separate your ATS tabs from your sourcing tabs. This prevents 'tab sprawl' and keeps your focus on one req at a time.
Set a weekly purge: Spend 30 minutes every Friday to archive old, unresponsive candidates so your search results stay relevant.

blocks.text: Lazur lives in your Mac notch. It helps you navigate complex ATS interfaces without needing to memorize every menu path. When you are stuck in a deep menu of your ATS, hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask where a specific filter is. Lazur circles the button on your screen so you can find it instantly.

You can also ask Lazur to explain what a specific setting does or guide you through a multi-step process like exporting a candidate list. Because Lazur sees your screen, it knows exactly which version of the ATS you are using.

faq.question: Does Lazur click buttons for me?
faq.answer: No. Lazur points at buttons and guides you through the steps, but it does not click, edit, or operate your ATS for you.

faq.question: Can Lazur search my ATS database?
faq.answer: Lazur cannot search your private database directly. It can help you find the search bar, explain how to use your ATS filters, or guide you through the process of running a search.

faq.question: Is my candidate data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. Lazur only looks at your screen while you hold the shortcut. Screenshots and audio are sent to AI providers to answer your request and are not stored or used to train models.

causes.title: Keyword-Only Search
causes.text: ATS systems often fail to recognize synonyms or related skills, missing qualified candidates.

causes.title: Stale Data
causes.text: Candidate profiles are often left unupdated, making contact info and job titles unreliable.

causes.title: Fragmented Workflows
causes.text: Recruiters often switch between the ATS, email, and spreadsheets, losing track of candidate history.

fixes.title: Semantic Search Optimization
fixes.text: Switch from basic keyword searches to AI-powered semantic search if your ATS allows it.

fixes.title: Browser Space Management
fixes.text: Use Chrome or Safari profiles to keep ATS tabs separate from sourcing tabs, reducing clutter.

fixes.title: Weekly Data Hygiene
fixes.text: Dedicate 30 minutes weekly to cleaning up your ATS and archiving unresponsive candidates.
